description: Test class for MessageMappingProcessorActor and OutboundMappingProcessorActor, containing unit tests verifying message processing, mapping, acknowledgement handling, placeholder replacement, error handling, and enrichment features in the messaging system.

classes.name: MessageMappingProcessorActorTest
classes.description: Unit tests for message mapping and processing actors in the Eclipse Ditto system, verifying system behavior in message handling, acknowledgements, error handling, placeholders, and enrichment.

methods.name: testRequestedAcknowledgementFilter
methods.description: Verifies the filtering behavior of acknowledgement requests based on filter expressions.

methods.name: testExternalMessageInDittoProtocolIsProcessedWithDefaultMapper
methods.description: Tests processing of external messages with default mapping in Ditto protocol.

methods.name: testExternalMessageInDittoProtocolIsProcessedWithCustomMapper
methods.description: Tests processing of external messages with custom payload mapper.

methods.name: testThingIdEnforcementExternalMessageInDittoProtocolIsProcessed
methods.description: Verifies enforcement of thing ID placeholders during message processing.

methods.name: testThingIdEnforcementExternalMessageInDittoProtocolIsProcessedExpectErrorResponse
methods.description: Verifies error response when enforcement of thing ID placeholders fails.

methods.name: testMappingFailedExpectErrorResponseWitMapperId
methods.description: Ensures that mapping failures produce error responses with appropriate error details.

methods.name: testSignalEnrichment
methods.description: Tests signal enrichment with target-specific attributes and header mapping.

methods.name: testSignalEnrichmentWithPayloadMappedTargets
methods.description: Verifies enrichment behavior when targets have payload mappings, including multiple and duplicated payloads.

methods.name: testReplacementOfPlaceholders
methods.description: Checks correct substitution of placeholders within authorization contexts.

methods.name: testHeadersOnTwinTopicPathCombinationError
methods.description: Verifies error handling for invalid topic and path combinations.

methods.name: testUnknownPlaceholdersExpectUnresolvedPlaceholderException
methods.description: Ensures unresolved placeholders throw appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: testCommandResponseIsProcessed
methods.description: Verifies that command responses are correctly processed and propagated.

methods.name: testThingNotAccessibleExceptionRetainsTopic
methods.description: Ensures that exceptions retain relevant topic information and correlation ID.

methods.name: testAggregationOfAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks correct aggregation of acknowledgements and validation of acknowledgement requests.

methods.name: testFilteringOfAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies acknowledgment filtering logic through request attributes.

methods.name: testAppendingConnectionIdToResponses
methods.description: Confirms connection ID is appended to responses and acknowledgements.

methods.name: sendAckWithoutDeclaration
methods.description: Tests handling of acknowledgements without prior declaration, expecting label-not-declared exceptions.

methods.name: forwardsSearchCommandsToConnectionActor
methods.description: Verifies that search/cancel commands are forwarded correctly to the connection actor.

methods.name: inboundQueryCommandDoesNotRequestAcknowledgements
methods.description: Ensures inbound query commands do not request acknowledgements by default.
